description_en: Issues a local debugging token for a running high-code agent in a specified workspace. The latest configuration of the agent must be in effect. The workspace must have inbound access enabled for the selected network and debug routing configured. The token is valid for 1 hour from the time of issuance. After the token expires, you can call this operation again to obtain a new one
description_zh: 为指定工作空间中已运行的高代码智能体签发本地调试令牌。智能体的最新配置须已生效，工作空间须已开启所选网络的入站访问并完成调试路由准备。令牌自签发起 1 小时内有效，过期后可重新调用本接口获取
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore create-custom-agent-debug-token --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --agent-id agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --network-type INTERNET --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomAgentDebugToken

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the high-code agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 高代码智能体所属工作空间的 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the high-code agent to be debugged locally
parameters.help_zh: 要在本地调试的高代码智能体 ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The network type used for local debugging. INTERNET indicates public network access, and INTRANET indicates access over a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh: 本地调试使用的网络类型。INTERNET 表示通过公网访问，INTRANET 表示通过专有网络（VPC）访问
parameters.name: network_type

code.description_en: The business status code. SUCCESS is returned if the call succeeds
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时返回 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The debugging token, token fingerprint, and the corresponding resource and network information issued in this request
data.description_zh: 本次签发的调试令牌、令牌指纹及其对应的资源和网络信息

agentId.description_en: The ID of the high-code agent corresponding to the token
agentId.description_zh: 本次令牌对应的高代码智能体 ID

bootstrapToken.description_en: The token used by the AgentCore SDK for local debugging. Keep the token secure. Do not write it to logs or commit it to code repositories
bootstrapToken.description_zh: 供 AgentCore SDK 在本地调试时使用的令牌。请妥善保管，避免写入日志或提交到代码仓库

networkType.description_en: The network type used by the token, which is the same as the networkType parameter in the request
networkType.description_zh: 本次令牌使用的网络类型，与请求中的 networkType 一致

tokenFingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint used to identify the issued token. You can use the fingerprint to troubleshoot issuance records
tokenFingerprint.description_zh: 用于识别本次签发令牌的指纹，可用于排查签发记录

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace corresponding to the token
workspaceId.description_zh: 本次令牌对应的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

message.description_en: The description of the request result

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
